description: List the customers on a recurring credit bundle (monthly, quarterly or annually), newest first: each subscription's customer, status, current period and when it renews, and why it was cancelled. Granting a recurring bundle starts one; each period end renews it with the bundle's credits plus the rollover. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_credit_bundle_subscriptions
